Genomic single-strand breaks and repair maps further suggest that TF retention at nicked DNA may influence local repair-factor accessibility. Together, these findings systematically map DNA backbone mechanics as a position-resolved layer of TF recognition across diverse protein families, showing how this layer can reshape binding specificity and may influence repair-factor accessibility.
papers.shortSummary: 핵심 주장: TF는 염기서열뿐 아니라 DNA backbone의 기계적 상태도 인식하며, 그 영향은 위치에 따라 달라진다. 방법: PIC-NIC으로 염기 정체성은 유지하면서 특정 위치에 nick을 넣어 DNA 역학을 교란하고 TF 결합을 비교했다. 발견: 15개 TF, 8개 구조 계열에서 대부분 위치는 허용적이지만 일부 nick은 결합을 크게 바꾸고 특이성을 재편했다.
papers.whyCare: PI의 TALE/ZF 및 편집기 단백질 공학에서 표적 결합을 서열 선호도만으로 비교하는 관행을 점검할 수 있다. 특히 같은 표적 서열에서도 backbone 상태에 따라 결합이 달라지는지 확인하는 재사용 가능한 assay 아이디어다.
papers.takeaway: DNA 표적 인식은 서열만의 문제가 아닐 수 있다. 동일한 염기서열에서도 위치별 backbone mechanics가 결합과 특이성을 바꿀 수 있으므로, DNA-binding 단백질의 설계·평가에서 이를 독립적으로 측정할 가치가 있다.
papers.skepticism: nick이 유발한 기계적 이완과 nick 말단의 화학적 효과를 분리하는 대조가 충분한가? 특히 결합 변화가 nick 위치에 따라 달라진다는 사실만으로 기계적 원인을 단정할 수 있는지 확인이 필요하다.
papers.blurb: PIC-NIC은 염기서열을 바꾸지 않고 DNA backbone mechanics가 TF 결합과 특이성을 바꾸는 위치를 지도화해, programmable DNA binders를 평가할 새 실험 축을 제시한다.

lensReasons.main: PIC-NIC은 염기서열을 바꾸지 않고 DNA 가닥 절단으로 역학적 제약을 교란해 15개 전사인자의 결합 특이성을 지도화했다. 구조·결합 자료가 기전을 뒷받침하며 DNA 결합 단백질 인식 원리에 참고가 된다.
lensReasons.computational: 분자 시뮬레이션과 구조 비교가 기전 해석을 보조하지만, 주된 산출물은 실험 기반 결합 지도다.

papers.title: TRIM47 drives cardiac ischemia/reperfusion injury by impairing mitochondrial function and fatty acid metabolism in male mice
papers.abstract: E3 ubiquitin ligase Tripartite motif-containing 47 (TRIM47) is integral in modulating metabolic processes and cellular homeostasis. However, its pivotal role and underlying molecular mechanisms in cardiac ischemia/reperfusion (I/R) injury remain incompletely understood. Here, we show that TRIM47 is markedly upregulated in cardiomyocytes during cardiac I/R injury in an early growth response 1-dependent manner, and that its expression positively correlates with the severity of cardiac I/R injury. Gain- and loss-of-function studies reveal that cardiomyocyte-specific TRIM47 overexpression exacerbates, while TRIM47 knockout attenuates I/R-induced cardiac injury, structural remodeling and functional impairment in vivo and in vitro. Mechanistically, upregulated TRIM47 facilitates K63-linked ubiquitination of forkhead box O1 (FOXO1) at K210 site to induce its nuclear translocation, where it interacts with and inhibits the transcriptional activity of hepatocyte nuclear factor 4 alpha (HNF4α), thereby aggravating mitochondrial dysfunction, fatty acid oxidation defects and cardiac I/R injury. Moreover, therapeutic knockdown of TRIM47 after I/R injury is highly effective in preventing cardiac remodeling and dysfunction. Our findings identify the role of the TRIM47/FOXO1/HNF4α axis in I/R-induced mitochondrial dysfunction, metabolic disorders and cardiac injury, highlighting the therapeutic potential of targeting TRIM47 to treat cardiac I/R injury in male mice.
papers.whyCare: The title describes a causal mitochondrial dysfunction mechanism, but its relevance to the lab’s mitochondrial engineering and editing work is uncertain.
papers.skepticism: Could provide mechanistic insight into mitochondrial function and metabolic readouts under stress.

lensReasons.main: 심근세포의 TRIM47 조작으로 심장 허혈·재관류 손상이 바뀌며, FOXO1 K210 유비퀴틴화와 HNF4α 억제를 거쳐 미토콘드리아 기능·지방산 산화가 저하됨을 보였다. 손상 후 TRIM47 억제 효과까지 제시한 강한 인과 연구지만 미토콘드리아 자체를 공학적으로 조작하지는 않는다.
lensReasons.computational: 계산 방법의 기여는 없고, 핵심은 생체 내·외 유전자 조작으로 밝힌 질환 기전이다.

papers.title: Single-cell transfer RNA sequencing reveals principles of translational regulation
papers.abstract: Transfer RNAs (tRNAs) decode genetic instructions from messenger RNA (mRNA) into protein, yet their abundance and regulation across cell states remain largely undefined, as multimodal measures of cellular tRNAs have remained elusive. Here, we develop a massively parallel assay for single-cell translatome and RNA sequencing (sctRNA-seq), which profiles transcriptome-wide mRNA and tRNA abundance simultaneously and chart the tRNA composition of 364,841 cells. Through multimodal perturbation screening of protein-coding genes and tRNA loci, we reveal dynamics across the mRNA and tRNA transcriptomes, delineating distinct tRNA-linked modules regulated by metabolic and Pol III-mediated transcription. Further, we uncover a close correspondence between codon demand and tRNA-mediated anticodon composition during hematopoietic multilineage commitment and differentiation. Tri-modal profiling of mRNA, tRNA, and proteins from primary human T cells reveals tRNA-mediated regulation that partially explains the discordance between mRNA and protein levels, particularly for selenoproteins and transcription factors. Finally, we uncover a stress-responsive tRNA module defined by gene-internal promoter sequences. Together, our analyses resolve tRNAs as a previously undefined layer of translational control underlying cellular identity and cell-state transitions.
papers.shortSummary: 세포 상태 전환과 perturbation에 따라 tRNA 조성이 조절되며, 이 조절이 코돈 수요 및 일부 mRNA-단백질 불일치와 연결된다는 주장이다.
papers.whyCare: 세포 상태와 perturbation에 따른 tRNA 변화를 단백질 수준과 함께 볼 수 있다면, 편집기 발현량이나 편집 효율의 차이가 전사량만으로 설명되지 않는 경우를 추적하는 데 유용하다. 특히 단일세포 perturbation 설계에 번역 조절 층을 추가할 수 있다.
papers.skepticism: 초록에는 tRNA 정량의 재현성·특이도와 유사 tRNA 서열 구분 성능, perturbation별 대조군 및 효과 크기가 제시되지 않는다. 관찰된 tRNA-단백질 연관성이 tRNA 변화에 의해 매개되는지, 또는 세포 상태 변화의 동반 현상인지 확인할 비교가 중요하다.

lensReasons.main: 단일세포에서 mRNA와 tRNA를 함께 측정하는 sctRNA-seq를 개발하고, 유전자·tRNA perturbation으로 세포 상태에 따른 tRNA 모듈과 코돈 수요의 연계를 밝혔습니다. 다중오믹스 스크리닝 기술로서 흥미롭지만 에디터 엔지니어링과의 즉각적인 연결은 약합니다.
lensReasons.computational: 핵심은 대규모 단일세포 실험과 다중모달 측정이며, 계산 분석은 결과를 해석하는 수단입니다.

papers.title: Surrogate Verifiers Shape Decisions in Closed-Loop Experimental Design
papers.abstract: High throughput, automated screening has revolutionized biological experimentation and prompted predictions of AI-enabled "self-driving" labs. Deployed autonomous lab systems typically use a learned surrogate to predict new experimental candidates and rank which conditions deserve expensive follow-up. Determining whether a computational surrogate verifier can substitute for an experimental assay's ground truth requires an understanding of model accuracy, uncertainty, and extrapolation. In this work, we present surrogate verifiers trained on N=7,688 Lacticaseibacillus growth curves exploring a 10-dimensional media component experimental design space. We train surrogate models across six distinct families including polynomial, Gaussian-process, tree-ensemble, neural, and Monod-kinetic forms to predict maximum optical density (OD600). Surrogates ranked by the most commonly reported accuracy metrics (held-out R^2; MAE; RMSE) disagree sharply on which experiments to test next and the best achievable yield. We evaluate models in a Bayesian optimization loop and find that the model used as the active learning oracle matters more than the acquisition function or batch size. We apply conformal calibration to build a model-agnostic assessment criterion of uncertainty and model coverage. We end by evaluating model accuracy and calibration under transfer to an unseen related bacterial strain, and confirm on a prospective validation plate that the transferred verifier's intervals fail in the direction and region our retrospective analysis predicts. This work explores the surrogate verifier within the loop as a previously underexplored axis of closed-loop design and points towards best calibration practices.
papers.shortSummary: 폐쇄루프 실험에서 surrogate verifier의 선택은 흔히 쓰는 예측 정확도 지표만으로 정당화되지 않으며, 실험 선택과 최적화 결과에 acquisition function이나 batch size보다 더 큰 영향을 줄 수 있다고 저자들은 주장한다.
papers.whyCare: AI 기반 편집기·세포 스크리닝에서는 surrogate가 단순 예측기가 아니라 다음에 검증할 조건을 결정한다. 따라서 평균 예측 정확도만으로 모델을 고르는 관행이 탐색 결과를 바꿀 수 있다는 점은 실험 설계와 모델 평가 기준에 직접 관련된다. 편집기 최적화에서의 효과는 아직 검증되지 않았으므로, 우리 데이터로 확인할 가치가 있다.
papers.skepticism: 초록만으로는 oracle 효과의 크기와 안정성을 판단하기 어렵다. 동일한 실험 예산에서 반복 seed·데이터 분할별로 surrogate 변경과 acquisition 변경을 비교했는지, 그리고 전이 검증의 표본 수와 coverage 수치가 무엇인지 확인해야 한다. 현재 근거는 미생물 성장 및 관련 균주 전이에 한정된다.

lensReasons.main: 박테리아 배지 최적화에서 대리 모델의 오차와 불확실성이 다음 실험 선택을 크게 좌우함을 보이고, 관련 균주 전이에 대한 예측을 후속 플레이트로 점검했다. 실험 최적화 루프 설계에 유용하지만 편집기나 연구실의 핵심 생물학에 대한 검증은 아니다.
lensReasons.computational: 여러 모델 계열의 성능·불확실성 보정과 베이지안 최적화를 비교하는 계산 방법론이 중심이다. 전이 상황의 예측 한계를 실험으로 확인했다.

papers.title: A split RNA-guided Cas9 system for PAM-independent and cis-cleavage-free nucleic acid detection
papers.abstract: The CRISPR-Cas9 system exhibits limited trans -cleavage activity, restricting its utility for nucleic acid detection. Here, we present a split RNA-guided Cas9 system (SCas9) that overcomes this limitation. By partitioning single-guide RNA into functionally independent scaffold and spacer modules, SCas9 enables amplification-free detection of single-stranded DNA and RNA with picomolar sensitivity within 30 min and single-nucleotide specificity. Incorporation of λ exonuclease permits PAM-independent detection of double-stranded DNA without cis -cleavage activity. Coupling SCas9 with recombinase polymerase amplification or reverse transcription–recombinase polymerase amplification extends detection of double-stranded DNA and long RNA to attomolar sensitivity. We further developed an autocatalytic SCas9 strategy for attomolar microRNA detection. SCas9 demonstrates broad substrate compatibility and was validated in clinical specimens, including human papillomavirus 16 in vaginal secretions and miR-21 in colorectal cancer tissues, highlighting its potential for point-of-care diagnostics.
papers.whyCare: A split Cas9 detection system with PAM independence and cleavage avoidance may offer useful design or recognition principles, although the title emphasizes detection rather than editing.
papers.skepticism: Cas9 architecture and PAM-independent nucleic-acid recognition could be relevant to programmable DNA-binding and editor engineering.

lensReasons.main: 가이드 RNA를 scaffold와 spacer로 분리한 Cas9 검출계를 개발해 PAM 비의존·cis 절단 없는 검출과 임상 검체 적용을 보였다. Cas9/RNA 시스템의 설계 혁신은 관련성이 있지만, 편집 성능이나 편집기 개선을 직접 검증한 연구는 아니다.
lensReasons.computational: 주된 기여는 split-Cas9 진단 기술의 실험 개발과 검체 검증이며 계산 방법은 핵심이 아니다.

papers.title: VapC40 diverts autophagic flux from xenophagy to mitophagy via ammonia-dependent metabolic toxicity
papers.abstract: Mycobacteria survive inside the immune cells meant to destroy them. Toxin-antitoxin systems, gene pairs that help bacteria withstand stress, are abundant in the Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex, yet their role in infection remains unclear. Here we show that the Mycobacterium bovis toxin VapC40 disrupts host nitrogen metabolism. VapC40 redirects glutamine catabolism in infected macrophages, producing excess glutamate and ammonia. Ammonia is transported into lysosomes through the transporter RHCG, raising their pH and rupturing their membranes. Ammonia then enters mitochondria, collapsing membrane potential and triggering oxidative damage. VapC40 recruits NIX to the damaged mitochondria and activates TBK1 on their surface, inducing mitophagy. At the same time, autophagosome maturation is impaired and fewer bacteria reach lysosomes, so the pathogen escapes clearance. Mice infected with VapC40-deficient bacteria show less ammonia toxicity and lung necrosis. These findings show that mycobacteria manipulate host nitrogen metabolism, and identify ammonia-induced organelle damage as a potential therapeutic target.
papers.whyCare: A mechanistic study of mitophagy and autophagic flux with an explicit metabolic driver, relevant to organelle quality control.
papers.skepticism: Mitochondrial quality control, mitophagy, and metabolic effects on organelle biology.

lensReasons.main: 결핵균 VapC40가 글루타민 대사에서 암모니아를 늘려 리소좀을 손상시키고, 미토콘드리아 막전위 붕괴와 NIX 매개 미토파지를 유도해 세균 제거를 방해한다. 생쥐 감염 결과까지 있는 강한 소기관 기전이지만 미토콘드리아 엔지니어링의 직접적 방법은 아니다.
lensReasons.computational: 계산·AI 방법이 주된 기여가 아니다.

papers.title: Macrophage-exacerbated viral lung injury and mechanical overdistension-driven bacterial superinfection replicated in a human lung chip
papers.abstract: Patients with influenza-induced lung injury exhibit disrupted lung tissue barrier and persistent viral load, accompanied by hyperinflammation, immune cell recruitment, and risk of bacterial superinfection. These complications are often exacerbated in patients undergoing mechanical ventilation. Leveraging an immune-competent human lung-on-a-chip (Lung Chip) lined by human lung epithelium co-cultured with monocyte-derived macrophages and interfaced with lung microvascular endothelium, we show that monocyte-derived macrophages play a central role in driving key features of severe influenza, including activated cell death programs. Physiological strain mimicking breathing motions supports lung homeostasis, whereas pathological strain analogous to mechanical ventilator-induced lung overdistension promotes secondary Pseudomonas aeruginosa infection. Computational gene network analysis combined with experimental validation identified SIRT1 as a candidate modulator of inflammation and susceptibility to bacterial superinfection, which can be mitigated using pharmacological SIRT1 activators. Together, these findings underscore the importance of incorporating macrophages into preclinical models of viral lung injury and establish an integrated workflow combining human Organ Chips and computational approaches for gaining insights into biophysical and molecular disease drivers while facilitating the identification of therapeutic targets and candidate countermeasures.
papers.whyCare: Reports causal disease mechanisms in a human lung-chip model; abstract is needed to assess whether the chip or its assays offer reusable organoid/model-system value.
papers.skepticism: Potentially relevant as an enabling human tissue-chip approach or a useful example of modeling interactions between mechanical stress, immune cells, and infection.

lensReasons.main: 면역세포가 포함된 폐 칩에서 인플루엔자 염증과 기계적 과팽창에 따른 세균 중복감염을 재현하고, SIRT1 활성화의 완화 가능성을 검증했다. 장기칩 모델과 질환 기전은 유용하지만 핵심 편집기 연구와는 간접적이다.
lensReasons.computational: 유전자 네트워크 분석을 실험 검증에 연결했지만 계산 방법 자체가 주된 기여는 아니다.

papers.title: Structure-guided design of a dual-antigen mRNA vaccine conferring broad protection against Henipaviruses
papers.abstract: Henipaviruses (HNVs), including Nipah virus (NiV) and Hendra virus (HeV), are zoonotic paramyxoviruses with high case fatality rates and pandemic potential. Despite their threat, no licensed vaccines are currently available for human use. Here, we present a structure-guided mRNA vaccine strategy that overcomes key challenges in antigen stability, fusogenicity, and cross-protective efficacy. Using rationally engineered NiV F glycoproteins stabilized in the prefusion conformation, we identify a lead candidate (F-205) that abolishes syncytium formation and elicits high prefusion-specific antibody titers. Through systematic combinatorial screening, we determine that co-delivery of F-205 (NiV-M) and G (NiV-B) antigens via mRNA–lipid nanoparticles induces potent neutralizing and cellular immune responses. In stringent golden hamster challenge models, this vaccine confers complete survival against lethal NiV-M, NiV-B and HeV challenge, with viral RNA undetectable in lung, spleen and brain after NiV challenge and significantly reduced viral burden after HeV challenge. We also introduce surrogate assays to assess F conformation and fusion activity under standard biosafety conditions, enabling iterative antigen optimization without live-virus handling. This study defines a broadly protective, mechanistically informed vaccine platform for HNVs and provides a generalizable framework for rational design of mRNA vaccines targeting class I fusion viruses.
papers.whyCare: This combines structural design with an mRNA vaccine, but appears focused on antigen and vaccine development rather than editor engineering.
papers.skepticism: Abstract may contain transferable antigen-design principles, structural methods, or mRNA delivery details.

lensReasons.main: 프리퓨전 상태로 안정화한 Nipah F 항원과 G 항원의 mRNA-LNP 병용으로 햄스터에서 여러 헤니파바이러스 치명적 감염을 방어했다. 항원공학과 조합 스크리닝은 탄탄하지만 편집기·전달 기술의 진전은 아니다.
lensReasons.computational: 계산 방법이 주된 기여가 아니다.

papers.title: Expansion and cytotoxicity of mucosal CAR+ T cells in enterocolitis associated with BCMA CAR-T cell therapy
papers.abstract: Ciltacabtagene autoleucel (cilta-cel) is a B cell maturation-antigen-targeting chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell product approved for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma treatment. Previously reported cases of post-cilta-cel immune effector cell enterocolitis (IEC-EC) have been described as a severe diarrhea associated with clonal CAR T cell populations. Here we report nine cases of cilta-cel-associated IEC-EC with CAR T cell-positive (CAR + ) infiltration in 158 cilta-cel-treated patients at MD Anderson Cancer Center (incidence of 5.1% at a 6-month landmark and 5.7% globally). Cilta-cel infiltration was the primary cause of IEC-EC, and all cases demonstrated monoclonal or oligoclonal T cell populations as measured by vector integration analysis, flow cytometry and T cell receptor sequencing. Patients with IEC-EC had 100-fold more CAR T cell persistence in the peripheral blood than patients without IEC-EC. RNA sequencing analysis revealed increased cytotoxic and inflammatory programs associated with the CAR + infiltrates relative to controls. Clonal vector integration occurred in introns of highly expressed genes without evidence of vector-mediated mutagenesis. Candidate driver mutations were sparse and heterogeneous, distinguishing IEC-EC from peripheral T cell lymphoma following CAR T cell therapy. In sum, we find that IEC-EC pathology represents a distinct, duodenum-predominant, clonal lymphoproliferative disorder characterized by the infiltration of clonal CAR + cytotoxic T cells into the gastrointestinal tract.
papers.whyCare: The title suggests functional analysis of engineered T cells in a clinical complication, but the work may be narrowly descriptive.
papers.skepticism: Could contain a reusable principle about engineered-cell expansion, cytotoxicity, or safety in tissues.

lensReasons.main: 158명의 치료 코호트에서 cilta-cel 관련 장염 사례의 CAR-T 클론성 침윤과 높은 말초 지속성을 분석해 독특한 독성 병태를 제시했다. CAR-T 안전성에는 의미가 있으나 편집기 공학과는 거리가 있다.
lensReasons.computational: 계산 방법이 주된 기여가 아니다.

papers.title: Graph-guided flow matching enables biologically informed prediction at single-cell resolution
papers.abstract: Perturb-seq enables systematic interrogation of massively parallel genetic perturbations at single-cell resolution, yet exhaustive characterization of the full perturbation space remains impractical. Here, we present Graph-guided Flow Matching (GFM), a generative framework that integrates biological knowledge graphs with latent flow matching to predict post-perturbation single-cell transcriptomes. Across multiple large-scale Perturb-seq datasets, GFM outperforms a strong linear baseline and current deep-learning models in predicting unseen single-gene perturbations, while training up to 30x faster and remaining robust with limited training data. GFM also demonstrates competitive performance in the two-gene perturbation prediction task when neither perturbed gene is observed during training. Ablation experiments show that combining flow matching with knowledge graphs enables accurate prediction of perturbation responses. Finally, GFM accurately calculates transcriptional consequences of HSP90AA1 inactivation and identifies target candidates unseen by the model in chronic myeloid leukemia. Our study establishes GFM as a biologically informed generative framework that predicts single-cell perturbation responses for prioritization of therapeutic targets.
papers.shortSummary: 지식 그래프를 flow-matching 기반 생성 모델과 결합하면, 학습에 포함되지 않은 유전자 교란의 단일세포 전사 반응을 기존 모델보다 정확하고 빠르게 예측할 수 있다는 주장이다.
papers.whyCare: Perturb-seq의 실험 공간이 너무 커서 전수 측정이 어렵다는 문제를 직접 겨냥한다. 미관측 교란의 예측이 재현된다면, 실험 후보를 좁히고 조합 교란 우선순위를 정하는 워크플로에 영향을 줄 수 있다.
papers.skepticism: 초록은 여러 데이터셋에서의 우수 성능과 빠른 학습을 보고하지만, 분할 방식·평가지표·데이터셋별 편차는 제시하지 않는다. 유전자 홀드아웃이 세포 상태나 경로 정보를 통한 누출을 막는지, 그래프 구성과 전처리가 결과에 얼마나 기여하는지 확인해야 한다. HSP90AA1 사례의 표적 후보가 독립 자료나 측정으로 확인됐는지도 핵심이다.

lensReasons.main: 지식 그래프와 flow matching을 결합해 미관측 Perturb-seq 반응을 예측하고, 제한된 학습 자료에서 속도와 성능을 보고했습니다. perturbation 및 표적 우선순위화에는 참고가 되지만 예측 후보의 실험 검증이나 에디터 개발은 초점이 아닙니다.
lensReasons.computational: 여러 Perturb-seq 자료에서 기준선·모델을 비교하고 미관측 유전자 조합 예측을 개선한 생성 모델 방법론이 주된 기여입니다.

papers.title: EpiPack: A computational framework for reference mapping and out-of-reference detection for single-cell ATAC-seq data with heterogeneous peak features
papers.abstract: Despite substantial recent advances in query mapping and cell type or cell state discovery tools, their application to single-cell assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using sequencing (scATAC-seq) data remains challenging. The heterogeneous nature of peak feature spaces across samples hinders the effectiveness of existing methods, while the absence of dedicated tools for detecting perturbed cell types and states in scATAC-seq data further limits the depth of downstream analyses. To address these limitations, we present EpiPack, an integrative computational toolkit that leverages heterogeneous transfer learning and graph-based modeling strategies to advance scATAC-seq analysis. At its core, the Peak Embedding Informed Variational Inference (PEIVI) framework within EpiPack enhances mappable reference construction, query mapping, and label transfer, demonstrating that leveraging heterogeneous features in scATAC-seq data outperforms methods relying solely on conventional homogeneous features. In addition, EpiPack’s global-local out-of-reference (OOR) detection framework achieves robust and efficient detection of perturbed cell types and states, extending the utility of scATAC-seq to disease and perturbation contexts. With its modular design and transferable pre-trained references, EpiPack can be readily applied to diverse analytical tasks and is available as a Python package at https://github.com/ZhangLabGT/EpiPack .
papers.whyCare: A computational method for single-cell chromatin data could be useful for epigenetics or screening analyses; its practical novelty and transferability need abstract review.
papers.skepticism: Potentially reusable for mapping and interpreting single-cell ATAC-seq in perturbation or cell-state studies.

lensReasons.main: 이질적 피크 특징을 활용해 scATAC-seq 참조 매핑과 비참조 세포 상태 탐지를 수행하는 분석 도구다. 후성유전·교란 데이터 분석에 재사용 가능하지만 편집기 실험과의 검증된 연결은 제시되지 않았다.
lensReasons.computational: 전이학습·그래프 모델 기반 분석 프레임워크가 주된 기여이며 scATAC 교란 상태 분석에 직접 적용된다.

papers.title: Staggered cryo-plasma FIB milling enables high-throughput cryo-ET
papers.abstract: Cryo-focused ion beam (cryo-FIB) milling combined with cryo-electron tomography (cryo-ET) is a crucial technique for studying macromolecules in their native environment. To mill thick samples, plasma ion sources are used. However, the practicality of high plasma currents, which offer the greatest potential for increasing throughput, and their possible damaging effects on the sample have not yet been investigated. Here, we systematically examine high-current xenon plasma-FIB (PFIB) milling and quantify the current-dependent damage in over 4700 tomograms by preparing a total lift-out volume of 9000 µm³. We find that currents of up to 2500 nA can be used in cryo-ET lamella preparations, enabling increased milling speeds and sample volumes that can be examined while maintaining sample integrity. We demonstrate this using a newly developed high-throughput staggered milling routine for waffle-like preparations, in which we achieve high-resolution reconstructions of yeast ribosomes, and for tissue serial lift-outs, enabling a complete experiment within 24 hours. Our results and approach provide a strong foundation for future in situ structural investigations of medically relevant protein complexes in organoids, tissues, or entire organisms.
papers.shortSummary: 핵심 주장: 고전류 xenon plasma-FIB와 staggered milling을 적용하면 시료 손상을 억제하면서 cryo-ET 시료 준비량과 속도를 높일 수 있다. 접근: 고전류별 손상을 4,700개가 넘는 tomogram에서 조사하고, waffle형 시료와 조직 serial lift-out에 staggered milling을 시연했다. 근거: 총 9,000 µm³를 준비했고, 최대 2,500 nA에서도 시료 무결성을 유지했다고 보고했으며, yeast ribosome 고해상도 재구성과 24시간 내 조직 실험을 제시했다.
papers.whyCare: 연구실의 구조생물학·세포 및 organelle biology 관심과 직접 맞닿는 방법론이다. 미토콘드리아 편집을 직접 개선하는 논문은 아니지만, 조직이나 세포에서 복합체를 제자리 구조로 분석할 실험의 실행 가능성을 높일 수 있다.
papers.takeaway: cryo-ET에서 고전류 사용을 일률적으로 피하기보다, 시료 손상과 구조 품질을 함께 측정해 허용 가능한 전류 범위를 정하고 staggered milling으로 처리량을 높이는 접근이 유망하다. 다만 실험실별 시료 특성에 맞춘 검증이 필요하다.
papers.skepticism: 최대 2,500 nA에서 무결성이 유지된다는 결과가 어떤 손상 지표와 대조 조건에 근거하는지가 중요하다. 고해상도 yeast ribosome 재구성은 유용한 품질 근거지만, 다른 시료에서의 세밀한 손상이나 조직 내부 위치별 차이까지 배제하는지는 별도 문제다.
papers.blurb: 4,700개 이상의 tomogram으로 고전류 cryo-PFIB의 손상 경계를 살피고 staggered milling을 시연한, cryo-ET 처리량을 높일 수 있는 실용적 구조생물학 방법론입니다.

lensReasons.main: 고전류 cryo-PFIB에서 시료 손상과 밀링 처리량을 대규모로 평가하고, 효모 리보솜 및 조직 lift-out으로 고처리량 cryo-ET를 보였다. 구조 연구에는 유용하지만 편집기 연구와의 직접 연결은 제한적이다.
lensReasons.computational: 계산 방법이 주된 기여가 아니다.

papers.title: Chromatin priming of skeletal stem and progenitor cells governs cell fate during bone repair
papers.abstract: Skeletal stem/progenitor cells (SSPCs) involved in bone regeneration reside in the periosteum and bone marrow, as well as in adjacent skeletal muscles. Given the diversity of SSPCs and their distinct contributions to healing, the regulation of their tissue-specific fate remains poorly understood. Here, we investigate how SSPC transcriptomic profiles and chromatin priming govern cell fate decisions in response to bone injury. We generate murine and human musculoskeletal stromal cell atlases that encompass all previously identified SSPCs, grouped into two transcriptionally distinct populations: CXCL12-abundant reticular (CAR) cells, restricted to the bone marrow, and PDGFRα + Sca-1 + (PαS) cells, predominant in the periosteum and skeletal muscle. Combined single-nucleus RNA and ATAC sequencing reveals CAR- and PαS-specific cis-regulatory elements at steady state in mice. We identify a Sox9 -dependent chondrogenic program in PαS cells that controls cartilage formation and is required for bone repair. Although PαS cells in the periosteum and skeletal muscle exhibit similar transcriptomes, we uncover distinct chromatin profiles that correlate with their post-injury fate. Periosteal PαS cells also show a specific osteogenic program involving the transcription factor DLX5, which drives bone formation. Chromatin priming in distinct SSPCs is thus a critical regulator of cell fate during bone repair.
papers.whyCare: A causal chromatin mechanism governing progenitor fate connects to the lab's epigenetics and cell-fate interests, though the tissue context is peripheral.
papers.skepticism: Could offer reusable principles for chromatin-state control of cell fate or regenerative biology.

lensReasons.main: 골격 전구세포의 단일핵 RNA·ATAC 분석과 기능 검증으로 Sox9 의존 연골 형성 및 DLX5 연계 골 형성을 제시한다. 조직별 크로마틴 프라이밍은 유용한 기전 사례지만, 골 재생 특이성이 높아 핵심 편집기 프로그램과의 직접 연결은 약하다.
lensReasons.computational: 다중오믹스 분석은 기전 규명에 쓰였으며, 계산 방법 자체가 주된 산출물은 아니다.

papers.title: Supervised deep learning for efficient cryo-EM image alignment in drug discovery with cryoPARES
papers.abstract: Cryo-Electron Microscopy (cryo-EM) is a pivotal tool for determining 3D structures of biological macromolecules. Current workflows are computationally demanding and require manual intervention, creating bottlenecks for high-throughput applications like structure-based drug discovery. In such contexts, where all protein samples can be assumed to be equivalent at resolutions relevant for image alignment, information about particle poses from previous refinements could be reused. Existing methods, however, ignore this prior knowledge, aligning each dataset from scratch. We present cryoPARES, a deep learning pose estimation method trained on pre-aligned datasets. Our method not only provides accurate angular predictions significantly faster than traditional approaches but also introduces automated particle pruning capabilities that eliminate manual intervention. Together with its single-pass operation, these features enable near real-time reconstructions that provide feedback during data acquisition. We demonstrate cryoPARES’s effectiveness through rapid structural determination of seven ligand-bound complexes across four distinct protein targets. We also release three fragment-bound cryo-EM datasets.
papers.whyCare: A deep-learning method for cryo-EM alignment could enable or improve structural studies relevant to the lab.
papers.skepticism: Could offer reusable image-alignment tools or benchmarks for structural analysis of engineered proteins and complexes.

lensReasons.main: cryoPARES는 기존 정렬 정보를 활용해 cryo-EM 입자 자세 추정과 선별을 자동화하고, 네 표적의 리간드 결합 구조에서 빠른 재구성을 보였다. 구조 연구의 처리량을 높일 수 있으나 편집기 연구에 특화되지는 않았다.
lensReasons.computational: 딥러닝 정렬 방법이 핵심이며 여러 단백질 표적에서 구조 결정으로 검증됐다. 구조 연구에는 유용하지만 편집기·전달 분야의 강한 검증은 없다.

papers.title: Where single-cell foundation models help: a public-data benchmark of annotation, in silico perturbation and gene regulatory inference
papers.abstract: Single-cell foundation models (FMs) are proposed as general tools for cell-type annotation, in silico perturbation and gene-regulatory-network (GRN) inference. To identify where they add value, we benchmarked five FMs (scGPT, Geneformer V1 and V2, Nicheformer, scFoundation), CellOracle, supervised perturbation models including STATE, and task-matched simple baselines on the same public data, from K562 Perturb-seq screens and primary cells to a brain organoid CRISPR screen, an in vivo Perturb-seq screen of the developing mouse cortex and lung cancer biopsies, using each model with its recommended settings and with tuned fine-tuning, under an analysis plan fixed before the new results. FMs were most useful when labels had to be transferred across species: from human to mouse lung, Nicheformer reached 0.98 accuracy with cosine kNN, above every baseline including CellTypist with tuned regularisation (0.94), and fine-tuned Geneformer V2 transferred labels from mouse to human with macro-F1 0.88, against at most 0.74 for baselines trained on the same cells. In K562, zero-shot perturbations captured the direction of real responses, with up to 76% of perturbations shifted in the expected direction (Geneformer V2, p < 1e-8), and with its native overexpression protocol Geneformer V2 tracked CRISPRa effect sizes ({rho} = 0.30, q = 0.001). Geneformer V2 networks recovered patient-level tumour differential expression better than co-expression (fold enrichment 2.9 versus 2.0, on five hubs). Within a species, FM embeddings did not exceed principal components: on 28,344 organoid screen cells the best FM reached macro-F1 0.78 zero-shot and 0.84 after fine-tuning, against 0.89 for principal components with kNN. In silico knockouts in the organoid screen and in the mouse cortex followed the expression of the target, moved embeddings no more than deletions of expression-matched control genes and met the predefined criterion in none of 46 tests, in which naive predictors such as the number of perturbed cells did as well. Fine-tuning changed classification accuracy and the size of predicted effects but not their ranking, gene networks or the advantage of a training-mean baseline. We release the benchmark, baselines and pipeline checks as the fmaudit package, so that new models can be evaluated on the tasks where FMs already help.
papers.shortSummary: single-cell foundation model의 이점은 과제에 따라 다르며, 종간 세포형 전이에는 유용할 수 있지만 같은 종의 주석과 knockout 예측에서는 단순 baseline을 넘지 못하는 경우가 많다.
papers.whyCare: Perturb-seq 및 AI-biology 분석에서 foundation model을 기본값으로 채택하기보다, 과제와 종간 전이 여부에 따라 단순 baseline과 직접 비교해야 한다는 실무 기준을 제시한다. 우리 연구의 교란 분석 파이프라인과 모델 선택을 점검하는 데 유용하다.
papers.skepticism: 표적·공여자 단위 홀드아웃과 데이터 누수 방지가 모델 간 비교에서 어떻게 보장됐는가? 특히 교란 예측이 새로운 표적이나 실험 배치로 전이되는지, 그리고 46개 실패 기준이 어떤 효과 크기·불확실성 측정에 근거하는지 확인이 필요하다.

lensReasons.main: 다섯 단일세포 파운데이션 모델을 Perturb-seq, 오가노이드 및 생체 내 자료에서 과제별 기준선과 비교해, 종간 라벨 전이에는 강점이 있지만 일부 perturbation 예측은 단순 기준선보다 낫지 않음을 보였습니다. 스크리닝 모델 선택에는 참고가 되나 직접적인 에디터·실험 역량 기여는 작습니다.
lensReasons.computational: 공개 데이터의 사전 계획된 비교, 튜닝 및 재현 가능한 fmaudit 패키지를 제공하는 모델 벤치마크가 주된 기여입니다.

papers.title: An optimized PanFlu-IOA-based mRNA vaccine targeting hemagglutinin confers broad-spectrum protection against heterosubtypic influenza viruses in mice
papers.abstract: The rapid mutation rate of influenza viruses necessitates annual updates of vaccine formulations, underscoring the urgent need for a universal influenza vaccine. Current computationally optimized antigen strategies are mostly confined to certain subtypes and thus fail to elicit broad-spectrum immunity against heterosubtypic strains. Here, we developed the PanFlu-IOA (Pan-Influenza Iteratively Optimized Antigen) toolkit to overcome systemic bias and extract universal antigenic features across diverse evolutionary branches. Using this toolkit, we generated two universal hemagglutinin (HA) sequences G1-HA and G2-HA for influenza virus Group 1 and Group 2, respectively. These two HAs were incorporated into an mRNA-lipid nanoparticle system to construct a broad-spectrum vaccine candidate termed panFluA. In mice, panFluA elicits robust cross-reactive humoral immunity, Th1-biased systemic CD4⁺ T cell responses, and cytotoxic CD8⁺ T cell activation, while successfully establishing durable lung-resident memory T cells. Notably, panFluA conferred potent cross-protection against lethal challenges with highly divergent Group 1 and Group 2 influenza viruses. Mechanistic studies revealed that this protection was mediated by the coordinated action of humoral and cellular immunity, as confirmed by T-cell depletion and passive serum transfer experiments. Overall, panFluA induced broad immune responses against conserved HA antigens. Our study provides a general strategy for next-generation universal influlenza vaccines.
papers.whyCare: The study is a disease-specific vaccine application, but its mRNA vaccine design or delivery approach could contain reusable engineering details.
papers.skepticism: Abstract may clarify whether PanFlu-IOA provides a broadly useful mRNA delivery or formulation advance.

lensReasons.main: 계산 최적화로 만든 두 HA 항원을 mRNA-LNP에 탑재해 생쥐에서 이종 아형 치명 감염에 대한 보호를 보이고, T세포 제거와 혈청 전달로 면역 기여를 확인했다. 항원 설계와 백신 효능은 강하지만 LNP 전달 자체의 공학적 진전이나 편집기 적용은 아니다.
lensReasons.computational: 항원 최적화는 백신 개발의 일부이고, 주된 기여는 면역반응 및 생쥐 감염 보호의 실험 검증이다.

papers.title: LRH-1 coordinates metabolic and epigenetic programs that establish luteal cell identity
papers.abstract: Despite advances in assisted reproductive technology, success rates remain modest, largely due to implantation failure and inadequate support of early pregnancy. Corpus luteum function and consequent progesterone secretion are essential for these processes. Large luteal cells are the primary source of progesterone production, yet the transcriptional programs that define their identity remain unclear. Here, we identify the nuclear receptor Liver receptor homolog-1 as a key regulator of large luteal cell function. Loss of Liver receptor homolog-1 disrupts lipid droplet accumulation and downregulates key steroidogenic genes. Mechanistically, Liver receptor homolog-1 undergoes chromatin-binding reprogramming during luteinization, establishing regulatory regions that couple lipid metabolism to steroidogenesis. Large luteal cells integrate energy metabolism with steroid hormone production and promote nuclear acetyl-coenzyme A synthesis via Acyl-CoA synthetase short-chain family member 2, linking metabolic reprogramming to epigenetic control. These findings establish Liver receptor homolog-1 and Acyl-CoA synthetase short-chain family member 2 as key regulators coordinating lipid homeostasis, chromatin regulation and fertility.
papers.whyCare: A mechanistic link between metabolism, epigenetic programs, and cell identity could inform the lab’s broader interest in epigenetics and cell-state biology, though the specific tissue context is distant.
papers.skepticism: Abstract may reveal reusable mechanisms or assays connecting metabolic state to epigenetic regulation.

lensReasons.main: LRH-1의 염색질 결합 재편과 ACSF2 매개 아세틸-CoA 합성이 지질 대사·스테로이드 생성·황체세포 정체성을 연결한다. 인과적 대사-후성유전 기전은 흥미롭지만 편집기나 실험 플랫폼의 직접 재사용 경로는 제한적이다.
lensReasons.computational: 주요 기여는 황체세포의 전사·대사 기전에 대한 실험적 분석이며, 계산 방법론은 핵심이 아니다.

papers.title: Phenotypic variation in Drosophila complex traits is influenced more by genotype and environmental interactions than by mitonuclear coevolutionary history
papers.abstract: The interdependent relationship between mitochondrial and nuclear genomes is a powerful model for understanding how epistasis shapes the architecture and evolution of complex traits. Once considered a neutral marker, mitochondrial DNA variation is now recognized as critical to phenotypic evolution because of its epistatic interactions and history of coevolution with the nuclear genome. A central challenge in evolutionary genetics is to quantify the relative importance of stabilizing and directional selection shaping complex trait distributions within and among species. Both can act on interacting and/or co-evolving genes contributing to quantitative traits, but resolving their relative roles is complicated by the complex architecture of most traits. Here, we use a panel of 90 Drosophila mitonuclear genotypes to quantify the relative contributions of mitochondrial, nuclear, and environmental variation and their interactions to four metabolically demanding complex traits. We sample both within-species and between-species mitochondrial variation and observe stronger interaction effects attributable to within-species variation, consistent with stabilizing selection maintaining mitonuclear function. Additionally, culturing the flies on a mitochondrial Complex I inhibitor, rotenone, reveals significant genotype × environment (G × E and G × G × E) interaction effects, providing insight into how genetic variation can be maintained across changing environments.
papers.whyCare: Tests how mitonuclear history, genotype, and environment relate to phenotypic variation; potentially informative for interpreting mitochondrial effects, though not an editing or organelle-engineering study.
papers.skepticism: Mitochondrial-nuclear interactions and environmental effects could inform how the lab interprets mitochondrial phenotypes.

lensReasons.main: 초파리 90개 미토-핵 유전자형에서 복합 형질에 대한 유전형·환경 상호작용을 비교하고, 로테논 조건에서 상호작용 효과를 보였다. 미토-핵 의존성은 미토콘드리아 연구와 맞닿지만, 공학적 조작이나 직접 적용 가능한 미토콘드리아 개입은 제시하지 않는다.
lensReasons.computational: 유전형·환경 효과의 비교가 중심이며, 새 계산 방법이나 편집기 설계용 모델은 제시하지 않는다.

papers.title: A hierarchical metabolic flux orchestrates cell cycle transitions in bacteria
papers.abstract: Mechanisms interlinking metabolic cues with cell cycle programs remain unknown. We show that an oscillating cytosolic redox critically governs cell cycle transitions in Caulobacter crescentus . By integrating evolutionary genetics with metabolic flux tracing, we uncover temporally orchestrated shifts in core metabolic pathways that remodel cytosolic redox across the cell cycle. Early stages channel carbon flux toward unsaturated fatty-acid synthesis and a reverse-TCA to drive cytosolic oxidation-coupled G1-to-S transition. The later stages depend on an enhanced forward-TCA cycle that promote cytosolic reduction-driven proliferation. Strikingly, perturbing fatty-acid synthesis or reverse/forward-TCA cycle uncouples growth from proliferation. Intriguingly, a biphasic glucose uptake program dictates the cell cycle-stage-specific metabolism. These findings reveal a previously unrecognized metabolic-redox circuitry that coordinates cell cycle progression in bacteria. They further unveil several metabolic branchpoints as promising targets for chemical intervention to disrupt critical and conserved cell cycle events, with potential applicability to bacterial pathogens.
papers.whyCare: A mechanistic link between metabolic flux and cell-cycle transitions may offer useful principles for interpreting metabolism-linked cell states, though the bacterial context limits direct transfer.
papers.skepticism: Metabolic regulation and cell-cycle coupling may inform broader organelle and cell-state discussions.

lensReasons.main: Caulobacter에서 지방산 합성과 역·정방향 TCA 흐름이 세포주기 단계별 산화환원 상태를 바꾸며 성장과 증식을 분리할 수 있음을 보였다. 대사-세포주기 기전은 탄탄하지만 세균 특이성이 높고 미토콘드리아 공학이나 편집기 연구로의 재사용은 분명하지 않다.
lensReasons.computational: 대사 플럭스 추적과 유전학적 교란이 중심이며, 계산 방법이나 공유 실험 분야에 검증된 AI 응용은 아니다.

papers.title: Selective mTOR inhibition via FLCN drives TFE3-dependent VLDL-TG secretion and protects from MAFLD/MASH
papers.abstract: Hepatic lipid homeostasis is controlled by multiple processes, including VLDL-TG secretion. We have previously shown that the FLCN/TFE3 branch of mTORC1 signaling controls hepatic fatty acid oxidation and de novo lipogenesis to protect mice from MAFLD. We now show that the FLCN/TFE3 pathway also controls VLDL-TG secretion via direct transcriptional activation of a broad program of genes involved in VLDL-TG secretion, including PCYT1A, the rate-limiting step of phosphatidylcholine synthesis. Loss of hepatic FLCN upregulates VLDL-TG secretion and prevents MAFLD, and this protection requires TFE3 and PCYT1A. The data unveil a new pathway that orchestrates multiple steps of VLDL-TG synthesis and secretion. The data also highlight that suppressing the selective FLCN/TFE3 branch of mTORC1 signaling maximizes hepatic lipid clearance by coordinately promoting fatty acid oxidation, suppressing de novo lipogenesis, and boosting VLDL-TG secretion, providing an attractive therapeutic target for the treatment of MAFLD.
papers.whyCare: A causal nutrient-sensing and transcriptional pathway in metabolic disease; possible relevance to organelle and metabolic regulation, but the connection needs confirmation.
papers.skepticism: mTOR–FLCN–TFE3 signaling and metabolic regulation relevant to organelle biology.

lensReasons.main: 간 FLCN/TFE3 경로가 PCYT1A를 포함한 지질 합성·분비 유전자군을 조절하고, 생쥐에서 VLDL-TG 분비와 지방간 보호를 연결한다. 인과적 간 대사 연구지만 편집기나 미토콘드리아 엔지니어링으로의 직접 전용성은 낮다.
lensReasons.computational: 주된 기여는 간 대사 경로의 실험적 분석이다.

papers.title: Chimera: Cross-Species Single-Cell Generative Modeling of Expression Deployment Relative to Protein Conservation
papers.abstract: A protein's sequence says what a gene could do in another species; the cells of that species say what it does there. Comparative genomics measures the first. Chimera measures the second, a gene's deployment, on the same genes and reports the difference. It aligns single-cell atlases across species in one generative model and returns, for every one-to-one ortholog, the evidence in the counts for a shared expression pattern, and {Delta}[a], the position of that evidence above or below what the protein's identity predicts. This difference is not sequence constraint under another name: across eight tissues, protein identity tracks dN/dS, whereas {Delta}[a] tracks neither. A gene therefore has two coordinates, not one, and the second can contradict the first: spermatocyte genes such as ZPBP2 keep their stage pattern on less conserved proteins, in eight held-out species, whereas conserved hepatocyte enzymes such as ALAS1 share their pattern but not their level. More broadly, genes of specialized cells sit above what their proteins predict in 23 of 24 cohorts, and approved drug targets do so more often than matched genes. Even among nearly identical proteins, where sequence can no longer tell genes apart, the count evidence still does. Nor does this rest on the model alone: independent data support the count evidence in liver and testis and, in a pre-specified test, {Delta}[a] in liver. With both coordinates, one can ask whether another species uses a gene as humans do, the premise of every animal model of a disease gene or drug target.
papers.shortSummary: 단백질 서열 보존과 유전자의 종별 세포 발현 배치는 서로 다른 축이며, Chimera의 Δ[a]는 단백질 동일성으로 예상되는 수준을 넘어서는 발현 배치 차이를 나타낸다는 주장이다.
papers.whyCare: 동물종에서 유전자의 세포·조직별 발현 배치는 단백질 서열 보존과 다를 수 있다는 점을 정량화하려는 방법이다. 재현되고 기존 비교법보다 예측력이 있다면, 종간 실험모델이나 표적 후보를 고를 때 서열 보존도만 보는 절차를 보완할 수 있다.
papers.skepticism: 일대일 ortholog에 한정된 분석이므로 복잡한 유전자군으로의 일반화는 불명확하다. 세포 유형 주석, atlas 구성, 측정 깊이 차이가 Δ[a]에 미치는 영향과, 이 지표가 단순한 종간 발현 비교보다 추가 정보를 주는지 확인해야 한다. 초록은 종·조직 홀드아웃 설계의 전체 범위와 기준선 성능을 충분히 설명하지 않는다.

lensReasons.main: 단백질 서열 보존과 종별 단일세포 발현 배치를 분리해 동물모델에서 인간 유전자 기능을 해석하는 관점을 제공한다. 모델 선택에 관한 개념적 참고는 되지만 편집기·전달·미토콘드리아 엔지니어링과의 직접 연결은 약하다.
lensReasons.computational: 종간 단일세포 atlas를 생성모델로 정렬하고 보존도 예측과 발현 배치 차이를 정량화한다. 여러 조직·종 및 독립 데이터로 count evidence를 점검했다.

papers.title: Symmetry-breaking antibody binding reveals extensive capsid malleability in pandemic human norovirus
papers.abstract: Virus capsids are metastable assemblies with an exquisite balance between stability and flexibility, obligatory for entry, infectivity, and immune escape. Yet the extent to which human viruses exploit capsid plasticity and how that consequently shapes antigenic landscapes remains poorly understood. Human noroviruses (HuNoVs) are the leading cause of acute viral gastroenteritis worldwide. GII.4 HuNoVs have been evolving epochally, driving most global pandemics, and since 2012, GII.4 Sydney has been the dominant variant. The major capsid protein, VP1, is central to infectivity and immune recognition, and VP1-based virus-like particles (VLPs) are considered promising vaccine candidates. Yet, how the icosahedral HuNoV capsid responds to antibody pressure at the atomic level remains unclear. Here, we present the first atomic structure of GII.4 Sydney capsid determined by cryo-EM, revealing the structural features that likely contribute to its sustained dominance. Using focused refinement, we uncover the remarkable capsid plasticity in response to symmetry-breaking binding of neutralizing and non-neutralizing antibodies. VP1 adopts 11 distinct conformational modalities to accommodate asymmetric antibody binding, and antibody-disrupted VLPs reassemble into smaller particles with five additional VP1 states. This previously unrecognized extent of conformational adaptability provides key insights for designing next-generation VLP- or mRNA-based vaccines targeting HuNoV infections.
papers.whyCare: A structural mechanism explaining capsid malleability may be useful to structural biology, although the norovirus system does not suggest a direct delivery application.
papers.skepticism: Abstract may offer reusable principles for capsid structure, conformational dynamics, or protein–antibody interactions.

lensReasons.main: 노로바이러스 캡시드의 cryo-EM 구조에서 항체 결합에 따른 다수의 VP1 구조 상태와 입자 재조립을 포착했다. 구조적 발견은 강하지만 편집기·전달·미토콘드리아 연구와의 재사용 경로는 제한적이다.
lensReasons.computational: 계산 방법이 주된 기여가 아니다.

papers.title: Morphogenesis of the muscular ventricular septum is driven by retinoic acid signalling to myocardium
papers.abstract: The mammalian heart is divided into four chambers by septa that isolate systemic and pulmonary circulation and are hotspots of congenital heart defects (CHD). The muscular ventricular septum develops between left and right ventricular cardiomyocytes derived from the first and second heart fields. Despite its clinical importance, mechanisms underlying development of the ventricular septum are poorly understood. Here we show that myocardial reception of retinoic acid (RA) signalling regulates formation of the compact septal core. Activation of a dominant negative RA receptor in second heart field-derived myocardium during septal morphogenesis results in a deep interventricular cleft and bifid cardiac apex. This phenotype is preceded by ectopic trabecular contributions to a RA-independent septal primordium. Molecular analysis identifies defective cardiomyocyte maturation and impaired RAC1 activation in mutant hearts. These results support an infolding and RA-dependent fusion model of septal morphogenesis, providing new insights into ventricular development and the origins of CHD.
papers.whyCare: A causal developmental signaling mechanism, but the title offers no specific link to the lab's core methods or biological systems.
papers.skepticism: Could inform organoid or tissue-model thinking about signaling control of morphogenesis.

lensReasons.main: 심근의 RA 신호 차단으로 심실중격 형성이 깨지고 심근 성숙·RAC1 활성 저하가 뒤따름을 보여주는 인과적 발생 연구다. 심장 발생 이해에는 의미 있지만 편집기·전달·미토콘드리아 공학의 구체적 재사용 경로는 제한적이다.
lensReasons.computational: 계산 방법이 중심 기여가 아니며, 편집기 설계와 연결되는 계산 기법도 보고하지 않는다.

papers.title: Single cell RNA sequencing reveals unexpected heterogeneity and identifies AP2XI-6 as a mature bradyzoite specific cell cycle regulator
papers.abstract: Toxoplasma gondii prevalence is due, in part, to its ability to persist in hosts while retaining the capacity to transmit and recrudesce. This process, while critical, is poorly understood. Through single cell RNA profiling of in vivo-derived bradyzoites, we show that bradyzoites are heterogeneous and not G1-arrested, as expected from in vitro studies. Instead, they progress through two distinct cell cycles that branch from a single G1 state. One is common amongst tachyzoites and in vitro- and in vivo-derived bradyzoites; the other is newly identified within the population of in vivo-derived bradyzoites. While in G1b, these in vivo-derived bradyzoites express cyst wall proteins predicted to replenish the wall that protects cysts and prevents clearance. We demonstrate that AP2XI-6, a putative AP2-transcription factor expressed by bradyzoites in G1 in vivo, is dispensable for tachyzoite growth and cyst formation in vitro but necessary for encystation or persistence in vivo. We propose that AP2XI-6 is a driver of replication through the newly identified in vivo bradyzoite specific cell cycle and that this is required for cyst maturation or persistence.
papers.whyCare: Combines single-cell profiling with identification of a specific cell-cycle regulator; its causal depth and potential reusable screening logic are unclear from the title.
papers.skepticism: Potentially relevant as a single-cell analysis and cell-state-regulation example.

lensReasons.main: 생체 유래 Toxoplasma bradyzoite 단일세포 분석으로 예상 밖 세포주기 이질성을 찾고, AP2XI-6의 생체 내 낭포화·지속성 필요성을 보였다. 기생충 생물학의 인과적 발견이지만 편집기·전달·미토콘드리아 공학과의 구체적 접점은 적다.
lensReasons.computational: 단일세포 RNA 분석은 세포 상태를 규명하는 수단이며 계산 기법 자체가 주된 기여는 아니다.

papers.title: Lysine-R2HGylation-C5 identified as a post-translational modification in R2HG-elevated cancers
papers.abstract: R -2-Hydroxyglutarate ( R 2HG), an oncometabolite predominantly produced by mutated isocitrate dehydrogenase 1/2 (IDH1/2) in various cancers, is known to drive cancer progression through noncovalent inhibition of α-ketoglutarate ( α KG)-dependent enzymes. In this work, we propose an alternative mechanism wherein R 2HG contributes to cancer development via covalent modification of biologically critical lysines, a process termed lysine- R 2HGylation (K R 2HG ). We designed and synthesized R 2HG-mimicking probes and demonstrated their effectiveness in facilitating K R 2HG target profiling and site mapping. We identified K R 2HG as a post-translational modification, confirmed its C5-linkage on GSTP1(K209), and demonstrated that SIRT5 functions as a deacylase for GSTP1-K R 2HG in vitro. Furthermore, we found that R 2HG slightly but significantly inhibits the enzymatic activity of GSTP1 through K R 2HG and dramatically suppresses monocyte differentiation via this catalytically important lysine modification. Our findings provide an alternative perspective on the role of R 2HG in leukemia progression and offer a practical tool for the clinical investigation of R 2HG-elevated cancers.
papers.whyCare: A potentially useful biochemical mechanism involving a metabolite-linked post-translational modification, but its broader relevance is unclear from the title.
papers.skepticism: Metabolite-dependent protein regulation and post-translational modification mechanisms.

lensReasons.main: R-2HG 모사 프로브로 리신 변형 표적을 찾아 GSTP1의 C5 결합과 SIRT5 탈아실화를 제시하고, 단핵구 분화 억제와 연결했다. 신선한 종양 대사 기전과 분석 도구지만 편집기·전달 연구와의 재사용 경로는 제한적이다.
lensReasons.computational: 주된 기여는 대사체 모사 프로브와 생화학 실험이다.

papers.title: A metal ion-assisted workflow for practical and scalable enrichment of small extracellular vesicles from biofluids
papers.abstract: Small extracellular vesicles hold immense diagnostic and therapeutic potential, yet clinical translation is hindered by inefficient separation and concentration. Current methods like ultracentrifugation and polymer-based precipitation suffer from low throughput or persistent contaminants. Here, we develop an optimized workflow that adapts the well-established binding between transition metal ions (copper(II), manganese(II), zinc(II)) and membrane phosphate groups to induce vesicle aggregation that facilitates small extracellular vesicle recovery from urine, blood and cell culture-conditioned medium using conventional centrifugation. We elucidate how buffer composition (albumin, phosphate, and hydron) and small extracellular vesicle surface properties (surface charge, phospholipid content) modulate these ion-vesicle interactions. By optimizing protocols using copper(II) for blood, zinc(II) for urine and cell culture-conditioned medium, we achieve higher yields than ultracentrifugation and polymer-based precipitation while preserving vesicle ultrastructure, molecular markers, biological function and safety. Thus, we establish a practical and scalable workflow that accelerates extracellular vesicle-based translational research.
papers.whyCare: A practical, scalable extracellular-vesicle isolation workflow; possible relevance to delivery research, though the title emphasizes biofluid enrichment rather than engineered delivery.
papers.skepticism: Abstract could clarify whether the workflow or vesicle characterization has reusable value for studying or developing delivery vehicles.

lensReasons.main: 금속 이온 응집으로 체액·배양액에서 소포를 고수율로 회수하는 실용적 방법이다. EV 기반 진단·전달 연구에는 유용하지만 편집기 전달이나 핵심 엔지니어링과의 연결은 약하다.
lensReasons.computational: 주요 기여는 계산 방법이 아니라 소포 분리 프로토콜이다.

papers.title: LRRK2-mediated phosphorylation of exocytic RABs disrupts neurotrophin/neuropeptide secretion
papers.abstract: Neuropeptide signals such as BDNF secreted from dense-core vesicles (DCVs) are essential for neuronal development, maturation and survival. RAB3 GTPases are established regulators of DCV exocytosis, but their functional diversity remains poorly understood. Here, we use live-cell imaging and neuropeptidomics to show that distinct exocytic RABs control DCV exocytosis in a neuron type specific manner, whereas RIM1/2 is a universal effector. Striatal neurons express both RAB3A and RAB27B but, surprisingly, only the latter controls DCV exocytosis. This is explained by selective phosphorylation of RAB3A by LRRK2, preventing its recruitment to DCVs. Finally, a LRRK2 hyperactive mutation associated with Parkinson’s disease disrupts DCV exocytosis in both hippocampal and striatal neurons. These findings uncover an unexpected diversity in controlling neuropeptide secretion in different neurons and establish LRRK2-mediated inhibition of RAB recruitment to DCVs as a powerful inhibitory principle that may also contribute to neurodegeneration upon gain-of-function mutations.
papers.whyCare: A specific kinase-to-trafficking mechanism in neuronal secretion; potentially interesting cell biology, but the title suggests limited direct relevance.
papers.skepticism: Mechanistic regulation of vesicle trafficking and secretion.

lensReasons.main: 뉴런 유형별 DCV 분비를 비교해 RAB27B와 RAB3A의 역할 차이를 밝히고, LRRK2 인산화가 RAB3A의 소포 모집을 막는 기전을 제시했다. 파킨슨병 관련 신경생물학에는 의미 있지만 연구실의 우선 엔지니어링 방향과는 거리가 있다.
lensReasons.computational: 주된 기여는 뉴런의 생세포 영상과 신경펩타이드 분석이다.

papers.title: Mapping dynamics of subcellular RNA and protein localization and organization using optimal transport
papers.abstract: Subcellular molecular polarity is essential for early development and represents a key layer for building virtual cell models that connect molecular organization to cell fate. Yet how RNA and protein localization patterns are established, erased, and rebuilt during the transition from oocyte to zygote remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we integrate high-resolution axial cryo-sectioning with multi-omics profiling across six stages of Xenopus laevis early development and develop an optimal-transport-based framework to quantify spatial polarity and temporal remodeling of molecular distributions. Here, we show that proteins, rather than RNAs, carry the dominant and rapidly remodeled polarity signature, undergoing polarity collapse from stage VI oocytes to unfertilized eggs and rapid re-establishment after fertilization; this protein-specific rewiring contrasts with relatively stable RNA localization, reveals uncoupling between transcript storage and protein spatial deployment, and provides a spatial multi-omics foundation for modeling early embryogenesis toward virtual cells.
papers.whyCare: A computational method for mapping subcellular molecular dynamics could be useful for organelle biology and spatial cell measurements.
papers.skepticism: Assess whether the method, data, or benchmarks transfer to organelle-localization studies or dynamic RNA/protein measurements.

papers.title: Distinct DNA-binding modes of Sp8 and Sp6 shape a hierarchical regulatory network in limb ectoderm
papers.abstract: Sp8 and Sp6 are closely related transcription factors expressed in the limb ectoderm, where they control proximo-distal and dorso-ventral patterning, yet their direct targets and molecular mechanisms have remained unclear. Combining genome-wide chromatin occupancy with transcriptomic profiling in vivo, we identify shared and specific targets and reconstruct the Sp8/Sp6 gene regulatory network, establishing Sp8 as its dominant, hierarchical node. Mechanistically, the two factors diverge: Sp8 binds DNA directly at canonical GC-rich Sp motifs, regulating targets including Fgf8 and Sp6 itself, whereas Sp6 acts as a transcriptional cofactor. Via indirect binding to AT-rich motifs through Dlx, both cooperatively regulate limb-patterning pathways, including Wnt, FGF, TGF-β/BMP, and Notch. Biochemical assays confirm that both form homo- and heterodimers and interact with Dlx5 through their zinc-finger domains. Together, these findings reveal how Sp8 and Sp6 orchestrate AER formation and dorso-ventral patterning, providing a mechanistic framework for congenital limb malformations such as split-hand/foot malformation.
papers.whyCare: Mechanistic comparison of transcription-factor DNA binding may inform regulatory biology and DNA-recognition design, but the specific developmental context may limit transfer.
papers.skepticism: Look for transferable principles linking binding mode, sequence recognition, and regulatory-network behavior.

papers.title: miProbe: microbial peptide repository of biological embeddings
papers.abstract: Microbial peptides represent a vast yet largely underexplored component of microbial dark matter, offering a valuable reservoir of bioactive molecules. Artificial Intelligence (AI) has revolutionized peptide mining, demonstrating high-throughput screening capabilities in tasks such as functional prediction and de novo design. To fully unlock the potential of microbial resource, we present miProbe ( https://www.biosino.org/iMAC/miProbe) , an integrative platform hosting 1.08 × 10 9 microbial peptides from disparate habitats. Uniquely, miProbe bridges the gap between raw sequences and AI applications by providing 8 TB of precomputed protein language model embeddings (e.g., ESM2-650M and ProtT5-XL-U50). Our analysis reveals substantial variation in peptide diversity and functional properties across habitats and microbial taxonomic groups, and highlights the utility of large-scale embedding resources in functional peptide mining. Equipped with robust APIs for seamless model integration, miProbe establishes a diverse and scalable data resource to accelerate AI-driven exploration of microbial dark matter and the rational design of novel therapeutics.
papers.whyCare: A peptide and embedding resource may offer computationally reusable data, though the title does not establish a direct engineering application.
papers.skepticism: Could be useful for protein or peptide representation learning if its data and methods transfer to functional protein engineering.

papers.title: A defence-in-depth strategy for securing AI-driven biological sequence design
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence can design biological sequences, from proteins to whole genomes, opening opportunities for medicine and biotechnology, but the same capability can be misused. The Wübben Sandpit conference brought together experts in biology, AI, biosecurity, ethics, medicine and policy to ask how the field can capture the benefits while managing the risks. Here we set out a defence-in-depth strategy that builds safeguards into every stage, from the data used to train models, to the models themselves, to the synthesis of physical DNA. We argue that responsible governance is not a brake on progress but a precondition for it.
papers.whyCare: Biosecurity for AI-driven sequence design could inform responsible use of computational biology tools, though the title suggests limited direct experimental relevance.
papers.skepticism: Abstract may reveal practical screening, safeguards, or design-workflow guidance relevant to synthetic and AI-guided biology.
